data.name: Ataa
data.gender_notes: Ataa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ataa is a name derived from the Arabic language. It means 'giver' or 'promiser'. This name is often used for boys in the Islamic community. In Islamic history, Ataa is mentioned in various Hadiths, where Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) uses the name to describe those who fulfill their promises. The name Ataa carries the meaning “Giver, Promiser” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ataa usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, promiser and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a giver and fulfiller of promises in one's daily life.
data.etymology: Ataa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Promiser.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ataa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عطاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: عطاء هو اسم عربي يعني الخير والبركة والرزق، مستمد من الجذر العربي عطى، الذي يعني الإعطاء والخير، وله تاريخ استخدام طويل في التراث الإسلامي كتعبير للشكر والرضا، ودلالة على الشخص المتيم بالخير والبركة

in_urdu.name: عطاء
in_urdu.long_meaning: عطاء ایک عربی نام ہے جو بھلائی اور برکت کے معنی رکھتا ہے، جس کا تعلق عربي جڑ عطى سے ہے، جو دینے اور بھلائی کے معنی دیتا ہے، اور اس کا استعمال اسلامی روایت میں شکر و رضا کے اظہار کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अता
